Definition: from G5259 and G1349; under sentence, i.e. (by implication) condemned:--guilty.
BiblicalUsage: The word hypódikos carries the sense of guilty, under sentence. In Romans 3:19, the text says "it saith to them who are under the law."
TheologicalSignificance: In hypódikos I find no hidden theology; it simply means guilty, under sentence.
